probes.check: The facade's probe-build block tracking: at SDL_Quit SDL frees what it allocated, and any block the facade never allocated fails the rule as ALLOC_HOOK_LATE(sdl3).

seeded_violation.description: Call SDL_SetHint(SDL_HINT_APP_NAME, "probe") before am_bind_sdl3_allocation(), so SDL allocates the hint with its default allocator.

probes.check: am_probe_sdl3_allocation(): SDL_GetMemoryFunctions returns the four sdl3 trampolines, and the facade's sdl3 counter rises across SDL_Init.

seeded_violation.description: Remove the SDL_SetMemoryFunctions call from am_bind_sdl3_allocation().

adaptation_notes: SDL_SetMemoryFunctions must be the first call into SDL, before SDL_SetHint or SDL_SetAppMetadata (SDL_stdinc.h); the memory phase guarantees this as long as no game code calls SDL earlier.
SDL's hooks carry no user data or alignment, so the glue defines one static trampoline set for sdl3 that tags each block for the facade.
Do not use SDL_GetNumAllocations as a probe: it returns -1 unless SDL is built with SDL_TRACK_ALLOCATIONS.
